B1.hamiltonian: H = sum_i S_i . S_{i+1}, periodic, spin 1/2

B2.hamiltonian: H = -sum Z_i Z_{i+1} - g sum X_i, periodic ring
B2.existence: fermion parity prod X_i = +1 (the Jordan-Wigner map with antiperiodic fermions is exact there) and a pure Gaussian state
B2.boundary_conditions: periodic spins = antiperiodic fermions in the even sector
B2.cc_formula: S(l) = (c/3) ln[(L/pi) sin(pi l / L)] + c1'  (Calabrese-Cardy 2004, Eq. 1.1, periodic)
B2.memory_note: dense 4000 x 4000 float64 matrices (128 MB each): K, U, V^T, G

B3.hamiltonian: W = 2H/(a g^2) = x sum (s+_n s-_{n+1} + h.c.) + (mu/2) sum (1 + (-1)^n s^z_n) + sum_{n<N-1} L_n^2 (Banuls et al. 2013, Eq. 2.6, l = 0)
B3.parameters: x = 1/(ag)^2, mu = 2 m_lat / (a g^2); M/g = (E1 - E0) / (2 sqrt x)
B3.existence: Gauss's law L_n - L_{n-1} = Q_n at every site with L_{-1} = 0 (zero background) and L_{N-1} = 0 (zero field beyond the last site); total charge 0

lattices.shifted (main): mu = -1/4, i.e. m_lat = -g^2 a / 8 (Dempsey et al. 2022): continuum m = 0

not_done.massive_case: not run: the ED continuum error (several per cent) cannot test the MPS values (5e-5) meaningfully
not_done.chiral_condensate: not run: needs the free-theory subtraction and a continuum control that N <= 22 does not give

B4.existence: unit norm and work register value y < N (the computational subspace the modular multiplication permutes)
B4.registers: counting t = 2n qubits, work n = ceil(log2 N) qubits, total 3n; Beauregard (2003) circuit: 2n + 3
B4.postprocessing: one run: continued fractions of k / 2^t, first convergent denominator q < N with a^q = 1 mod N; factor gcd(a^(r/2) - 1, N) if r is even and a^(r/2) != -1 mod N

cost_map.note: wall times measured single-threaded on a shared 4-core machine; memory = 16 bytes per amplitude (complex128); seconds_per_gate = seconds_per_layer / n, i.e. per qubit for one layer with the n - 1 CZ gates folded in, so seconds_per_gate_per_amplitude is per qubit and amplitude for one layer
